sources.title: [2205.01580] Better plain ViT baselines for ImageNet-1k
sources.snippet: It is commonly accepted that the Vision Transformer model requires sophisticated regularization techniques to excel at ImageNet-1k scale data. Surprisingly, we find this is not the case and standard data augmentation is sufficient.
